statement: No src directory holds more than 120 .js files directly (control-plane 256, rebalancer 243, partition 159, query 127 at e29e295a6): the overflow moves into owner-named subdirectories with import paths updated and file contents otherwise byte-identical, the generated INDEX.md files are regenerated, and the budget row source_directories_over_cap reads zero; this quest runs after every source-changing quest of the epic has landed, because a move conflicts with any concurrent edit of the moved file.

constraints.statement: A new subdirectory is named for the owner or decision it holds, never for an ordinal or a grab-bag term, as code-style.md requires of files.
A moved file keeps its content byte-identical except import paths. A behaviour change travels in its own quest.
The 120-file cap only tightens; raising it is a refusal, not an option.
Starts only after the other source-changing quests of this epic have landed on the stream branch.
